description: Add players to the roster in bulk (parse pasted lists or spreadsheets yourself and send structured entries — never invent placeholder names; use signup mode when names aren't known yet). Duplicate names are rejected for disambiguation. If an unlocked draw exists it is regenerated automatically. Americano/mexicano take late arrivals even after results exist: americano rebuilds the rounds nobody has started, mexicano pairs them into the next round.

level.description: Any consistent numeric level/rating — used only for seeding and balancing

request_id.description: Optional idempotency id — retrying a call with the same id never applies it twice

tournament_key.description: The tournament's organiser key (starts with tk_)

name: add_players

preview.description: True when this is a preview — nothing was changed
